rows.note: This is the all-purpose Hong Kong Cantonese term for a road traffic circle.

example.english: At the roundabout ahead, keep left and do not take the wrong lane.
example.traditional: 前面個回旋處要靠左行，唔好駛錯線。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 go3 wui4 syun4 cyu3 jiu3 kaau3 zo2 haang4 m4 hou2 sai2 co3 sin3

rows.note: Use this for the fairground ride with model horses or similar seats.

example.english: The kids love riding the roundabout.
example.traditional: 細路仔最鍾意坐旋轉木馬。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 co5 syun4 zyun2 muk6 maa5

rows.note: Use this when naming a detour itself, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: This roundabout is a good way to avoid the traffic jam.
example.traditional: 呢條繞道係避開塞車嘅好方法。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 jiu5 dou6 hai6 bei6 hoi1 sak1 ce1 ge3 hou2 fong1 faat3

rows.note: Use this for the flat spinning playground apparatus on which children ride.

example.english: The children are having fun on the roundabout.
example.traditional: 細路仔喺氹氹轉上面玩得好開心。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 hai2 tam4 tam2 zyun3 soeng6 min6 waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1
